_notes: Musician data for weddingday2.ie. 'events' uses: ceremony (ceremony & drinks reception), day2, afterdinner. 'tradBand' and 'duo' are true/false. Add a musician's videos as {id, seconds} using the Squarespace video ID. Photos are Squarespace image paths after imageBase. Do not add prices here: this file is public. Optional 'photoPosition' (e.g. 'center 4%') moves the crop of a tall photo so the face stays in the wide banner. Each video has 'shape': 'tall' (filmed upright) or 'wide'. A video can have an optional 'poster' (a Squarespace image path) to replace its automatic thumbnail. Optional 'hideName': true hides the musician's name on cards and their profile (the name is still used in the enquiry form);

musicians.name: Musician A
bio: He is a professional singer-guitarist specialising in weddings and private events. Blending modern hits, classic anthems and Irish favourites, he delivers high-energy, singalong sets tailored to each event.
Known for seamless medleys and having fun with the crowd, he keeps the dance floor full from start to finish and happily takes requests.

musicians.name: Musician B
bio: Hailing from the West of Ireland, he is a seasoned musician known for bringing energy, atmosphere, and unforgettable live performances to weddings across the country.

With years of experience playing hundreds of weddings, appearances on national TV, and performances at major festivals, he combines powerful vocals with top-class guitar playing to keep every crowd entertained from start to finish.

musicians.name: Musician C
bio: With over eight years of experience and performances at more than 1000 weddings and events across Ireland, he has developed a versatile show that can be tailored to your specific needs.
Unlike most solo performers, he utilises a unique set of tools and techniques to create a fully live wedding music experience that cannot be replicated.

musicians.name: Musician D
bio: He has nearly a decade of experience performing at weddings and events across Ireland and internationally.
Through this, he has built a unique and lively sound which gives the energy of a full band in a more personal setup. He also covers a wide mix of hits to keep the day flowing.

musicians.name: Musician E
bio: He is a professional singer and guitarist with over ten years experience on some of Ireland & The UK's biggest stages.
Whether you wish to create a relaxed, mellow atmosphere during the early stage of your Day Two, or an upbeat, feel-good vibe later into the night, he has the setlist for you!
He is also happy to work with couples on selecting the perfect soundtrack for their day, whether it's that favourite song or just simply a preferred genre.

musicians.name: Musician F
bio: He is an incredibly talented musician who has performed at multiple weddings, Day 2's, and festivals all across Ireland.

Playing a mix of Irish favourites and dance classics on guitar, he creates the perfect atmosphere for any wedding day 2. With years of experience entertaining crowds, he brings great energy and plenty of craic to every event.

musicians.name: Musician G
bio: He is a professional singer-guitarist specialising in weddings and private events across Ireland.

With a relaxed acoustic style and a repertoire spanning modern chart hits, timeless classics and Irish favourites he creates the perfect atmosphere for every event. Every performance is tailored to suit the guests, ensuring the music feels personal and memorable.

musicians.name: Musician H
bio: He is a singer-songwriter and multi-instrumentalist who has won two National Song Contests as well as an IMRO award.
He has played with some of the biggest acts in Ireland and the UK including The Coronas, Mundy, 5ive and Aslan and has been playing music all over the world for the past 15 years.
He plays a wide range of music from the 60s up to the hits of today as well as some traditional music to make the perfect soundtrack to your day two.

musicians.name: Musician I
bio: He is a Galway-based musician with over 10 years of experience playing at weddings and events.
He's known for keeping things relaxed while still getting people on the dance floor, mixing crowd favourites with a few personal touches, and the occasional harmonica thrown in.

musicians.name: Musician J
bio: Whether it's upbeat party music or laid-back acoustic vibes, he has all the bases covered. With a huge repertoire of over 700 songs, he is more than happy to take requests and be your very own human jukebox.
He has toured and performed across the UK, Ireland, Europe and America as a guitarist and vocalist with the legendary Sinéad O'Connor, making him incredibly experienced and ideal for any occasion.

musicians.name: Musician K
bio: He is a live musician known for his strong vocal ability and high-energy performances.
With a natural talent to read the crowd, he keeps the vibe upbeat and engaging from start to finish.
With years of experience entertaining crowds across Ireland, he has built a setlist featuring modern hits, creative mashups, and classic sing-along favourites.

musicians.name: Musician L
bio: He is an incredibly gifted guitarist and outstanding singer who brings the perfect atmosphere to any wedding day 2 celebration.
His style blends popular contemporary songs with touches of traditional Irish music, creating a warm, lively, and memorable experience for guests of all ages.
Whether performing laid-back acoustic favourites or getting everyone up dancing and singing along, his talent, charm, and love of music make him a highlight of any wedding celebration.

musicians.name: Musician M
bio: He is a Dublin-based singer, guitarist and multi-instrumentalist with over 18 years of professional performing experience.

Since beginning his career on the Irish pub circuit in 2008, he has gone on to perform at more than 1,000 weddings, drinks receptions, ceremonies, day-two celebrations, private events and corporate functions across Ireland, Europe and South America.

Whether it's creating the perfect atmosphere for a wedding ceremony, providing easy-listening music for a drinks reception, or getting a crowd singing along late into the evening, he tailors every performance to suit the occasion.

musicians.name: Musician N
bio: He is an experienced Irish musician who has performed at weddings and events across Ireland and the U.S.

Known for his relaxed style and wide-ranging setlist, he adapts to every crowd, whether it's providing the perfect soundtrack for a drinks reception or wedding day 2, getting guests singing along later in the day.
He has an incredible voice, is passionate about live music and brings great energy to every event.

musicians.name: Musician O
bio: He is a Cork-based singer and guitarist who brings great energy and plenty of personality to weddings and events across Ireland.

Whether you want a relaxed, laid-back soundtrack for your drinks reception or someone to get the whole crowd up singing and dancing later in the day, he reads the room and keeps the atmosphere just right from start to finish.

musicians.name: Musician P
bio: Born in Mayo, he has been singing and playing the guitar for two decades and is a familiar face in the lively Temple Bar area.
He enjoys playing a mix of modern and classic songs in rock, pop, and folk styles. With dynamic and engaging performances, he has captivated music enthusiasts throughout Ireland and abroad.

musicians.name: Musician Q
bio: He is a solo singer-guitarist who plays weddings and private events all over Ireland. His sets are made for the dance floor: upbeat and feel good, moving from current chart hits to party anthems and much loved classics without a break in the energy.

He reads a room well and adjusts the set to suit it, so guests are singing along from the first song to the last. Requests are always welcome, which helps every celebration feel like it was put together just for you.

musicians.name: Musician R
bio: He is a talented guitarist and singer with a real love for traditional Irish music. Whether it's a lively trad set, much-loved Irish ballads or a few modern favourites with a trad twist, he brings a warm, authentic feel that gets everyone involved.

musicians.name: Musician S
bio: He is a full-time singer and guitarist who specialises in weddings and private events.

His set list runs from timeless classics to the latest chart hits, with everything in between. He reads the room and builds the energy, and he has one goal: getting your guests up on their feet, and singing along.
From the first dance to the last song of the night, he brings the live music that turns a great day into an unforgettable party.

musicians.name: Musician T
bio: She is a singer and guitarist with a soft, soulful voice that suits the quieter moments of a wedding day.
From walking down the aisle to the drinks reception, she plays stripped-back acoustic versions of well-known songs, from Hozier to Neil Young, and is happy to learn a song that's special to you.

musicians.name: Musician U
bio: An acoustic singer and guitarist for your ceremony and drinks reception. He plays stripped-back covers, from Lewis Capaldi to the classics, and can learn a song for your first walk down the aisle.

musicians.name: Modern Trad Band
bio: Bringing a fresh twist to traditional Irish music, our Modern Trad Band blends contemporary hits, much-loved Irish favourites and lively traditional instrumentals to create a unique sound that gets everyone involved.

Available as a dynamic duo or a lively trio, the band is completely customisable to suit your event. Whether you're looking for a standalone act or want to add an extra dimension to one of our solo musicians, we can create the perfect combination.

musicians.name: DJ
musicians.cardText: Keep the dance floor full all night.
bio: Keep the celebrations going with a professional DJ who knows how to create an unforgettable party atmosphere.

Our experienced DJs read the room and keep the dance floor packed from the first song to the very last, picking up seamlessly where your live music leaves off. Every DJ set includes professional audio and lighting.
Want to take it further? Add a live saxophonist or karaoke to your DJ set.

musicians.name: DJ & Sax
musicians.cardText: A DJ with a live sax player. A live twist on the party.
bio: Take your DJ set to the next level with one of our talented live saxophone players.

Combining the energy of a live sax performance with the seamless flow of a professional DJ set creates an unforgettable atmosphere for you and your guests. Our saxophonists blend effortlessly with the music and adapt to the mood of the evening.
It's the perfect way to add a unique, vibrant and sophisticated touch to your Day 2 or evening reception.

musicians.name: Karaoke
musicians.cardText: A DJ with karaoke. Hand the mic to your guests.
bio: Hand the mic to your guests with our karaoke add-on, run alongside your DJ.

It includes fully licensed karaoke software with thousands of high-quality backing tracks across every genre, plus professional sound equipment, microphones and everything needed for a smooth, fun karaoke session.
Karaoke can be added to any DJ booking.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Everything couples usually ask us about booking live music for their Wedding Day 2, ceremony or evening. Can't find your answer? Send us a message and we'll get back to you.

items.a: Every musician on our roster is hand-picked for their live performance and experience at weddings. You deal with one team from enquiry to the last song, professional audio and lighting are included, and your day is protected by our musician replacement and deposit guarantees.

items.q: What happens if our musician is sick or can't make it?
items.a: You're covered by our musician replacement guarantee. If your musician is ill or can't perform for any reason, we'll arrange a replacement of the same standard from our roster, so your day goes ahead with great live music.
Yes. Your deposit is covered by our deposit guarantee. If we can't provide the music you've booked, you won't lose out.

items.q: How much does live music cost?
items.a: Prices depend on the musicians you choose and the extras you add. Every booking includes a 2-hour performance per act plus professional audio and lighting. You can build your own package and see an estimated price on our packages page, or send us your date and we'll send you a quote.

Send us an enquiry with your date and the musicians you like (or build your package). We'll check availability and come back to you by email. To secure your date we take a deposit, and the balance is paid on the day.

items.q: Can we choose a specific musician?
items.a: Yes. Every musician has their own page with videos and a bio. We'd suggest picking a few favourites in case your first choice is already booked on your date, or choose "No preference" and we'll match you with someone great.

items.q: How far in advance should we book?
items.a: As soon as you have your date. Weekends from May to September are our busiest and the most popular musicians get booked up early.
Additional travel fees may apply depending on where your event is. We'll let you know the full price before you book.
Yes. We play weddings all over Ireland and are happy to talk about destination weddings abroad. Just tell us where in your enquiry.

items.q: What kind of music do your musicians play?
items.a: A mix of modern hits, classic singalongs and Irish favourites, tailored to your crowd. Whether you want a relaxed, laid-back set or the whole room up dancing, we'll match the music to the moment.
Most of our musicians are happy to take requests. Let us know any must-play songs, or songs to avoid, when you enquire or in the lead-up to your day.

items.q: Do you play the ceremony and drinks reception?
items.a: Yes. Many of our musicians play ceremonies and drinks receptions as well as Day 2s and after dinner. You can see what each musician plays on their profile.

items.q: What is the modern trad band?
items.a: Our modern trad band blends contemporary hits, Irish favourites and lively trad instrumentals. Choose a duo (musician plus fiddle or banjo) or a trio (musician plus fiddle and banjo). It can be booked on its own or added after your solo musician. See the trad band page.

items.q: Can we add a DJ, karaoke or sax?
items.a: Yes. A DJ is a great way to keep the party going after the live music, and you can add karaoke or a live saxophonist to the DJ. You can see prices on our packages page.

items.q: Can we have more than 2 hours of music?
items.a: Absolutely. Our packages give you 4 or 6 hours of live music, for example two musicians back to back, or a solo musician followed by a trad band and DJ. Have a look at the packages.

items.q: Do you bring your own sound and lighting?
items.a: Yes. Every booking includes professional audio and lighting, so there's nothing extra for you or your venue to organise.

items.q: Do you work with our venue?
items.a: We play venues all over Ireland. Have a look at our venues page for some of the places we love, and tell us your venue when you enquire.
